title: DUOS meta-learns update rules for opponent shaping in simulated games
summary: DUOS meta-trains an update rule that learns from an agent’s own experience without access to opponent parameters, policies, rewards or learning rules at deployment. In simulated general-sum games it ranked first in normalized mean score and self-play among tournament entrants; this is limited to the reported games.
